sources.use: gainers list only (price and percent_change come with it)
symbols only; top reduced from 50 to 25 to keep the snapshot step small

filters_in_order.name: symbol_pattern
filters_in_order.rule: drop '.WS', '.RT', and 5-letter symbols ending W/R/U/Z (warrants, rights, units)

filters_in_order.name: price_and_change
filters_in_order.tool: get_stock_snapshot feed=delayed_sip (one batched call, only for symbols without a movers price)
filters_in_order.rule: dailyBar.c (or movers price) >= equity.universe.min_price; change % = c/prevDailyBar.c - 1

filters_in_order.name: rank
filters_in_order.rule: sort by today's change %, highest first; take the top 8 into the expensive filters

filters_in_order.name: avg_dollar_volume_30d
filters_in_order.tool: get_stock_bars timeframe=1Day days=44 feed=sip end=now-16min (one batched call, limit 400)
filters_in_order.rule: sum(v*vw)/30 over the 30 sessions before today >= equity.universe.min_avg_dollar_volume_usd

filters_in_order.name: asset_check
filters_in_order.rule: tradable; fractionable if the order would be fractional; name not matching leveraged/inverse ETF terms (2X, 3X, Ultra, Bull, Bear, Inverse, Short, -1X)

filters_in_order.name: pct_below_52w_high
filters_in_order.tool: get_stock_bars timeframe=1Week start=today-365d feed=sip (one batched call for survivors)
filters_in_order.rule: close within equity.universe.max_pct_below_52w_high of max weekly high, unless §3b earnings-gap applies
filters_in_order.deviation_note: strategy.md §1 names 1Day bars; max of weekly highs equals max of daily highs over the same weeks (window edge differs by < 1 week) at about 1/5 of the data. Proposed in state/proposals.md.

filters_in_order.name: spread
filters_in_order.rule: spread <= equity.entry.max_spread_pct (evaluated at entry time, not in the scan)

filters_in_order.name: cap
filters_in_order.rule: stop after equity.max_candidates_per_run survivors; those go to strategy.md §3a/§3b

first_run_result.note: run after the close; movers lists and snapshots reflect the 2026-10-20 session; first run used most_active top=50
first_run_result.observation: BRZE +51.7% on 64.8M shares with a 45.26-45.61 intraday range: consistent with a pending cash acquisition (price pinned to a deal price). Not verified. A breakout entry on a deal-pinned stock has little upside; see proposals.

token_cost_note: First run: the 50-symbol delayed_sip snapshot and the 10-symbol daily bars were the largest responses (~20k and ~25k tokens). Hourly runs should stay within one snapshot call of <= 30 symbols and bars for <= 8 symbols.
